Thank you for getting in touch. The $299.00 charge is for your annual Core Coaching subscription. It was billed on November 15, 2025, when the subscription started, and it covers the plan's first year (November 15, 2025 to November 15, 2026).

Regards,
Northwind Fitness Co. Support

Once verified, we will share the status and delivery details for the order.

Kind regards,
Northwind Fitness Co. Support
